claim: Compiler optimizations are proven equivalent to the original program over every possible input (2^(64n) for n 64-bit inputs) via SMT, fail-closed, before artifacts ship.
attestation: The certified-compilation toolchain (SMT total-equivalence gates, certified superoptimization, transitive composition to the final artifact) exists, is CI-gated, and is exercised continuously in private repositories. We attest to this; you cannot currently check it, and we state that plainly rather than imply otherwise.

public_traces.note: Artifacts produced BY the private toolchain run publicly in-browser (compiler-as-WASM, re-executable figures), demonstrating outputs of the pipeline without exposing it.

how_to_upgrade_status: A public verification package (pinned artifact + re-runnable equivalence check on a bounded example) is planned; serious counterparties can arrange deeper verification under agreement: info@coherenceenergylabs.com.
limitations: Equivalence proofs cover the optimization and lowering steps in the certified lane for supported language constructs; they do not cover OS, hardware, or unverified library boundaries.
